data.title: Brick Wall 1
data.statement:
The goal is to build a wall using LEGO bricks. All bricks are 1 large, the wall also must be 1 large, so don't try to turn bricks.

In input you have the wall on face view, Each brick item is represented by a color character. The wall can have windows.
Then you have a set of bricks to use, you can have more bricks than needed.

The goal is to give the build instructions. for that you'll give in order which brick to use on a horizontal position. The vertical is position is the lower possible so bricks are stacked on previous ones.

Condition : the wall must be stable, it must be impossible to split it on several sections.

Example :
Input
2
b1 1 W 6 
b3 3 W 6 
3
3
WWW
W W
WWW

Output
b3 0
b1 0
b1 2
b3 0

Only one solution is possible. In previous example, using b1 bricks instead of b3 make the wall instable.

Remarks
- level 2 add plates and tiles

data.constraints: Write solution with bricks from bottom then left to right
data.stubGenerator:
read N:int
loop N read brickName:word(10) brickSize:int color:word(1) count:int
read H:int
read W:int
loop H read line:string(W)
write answer
data.inputDescription:
<<Line 1 :>> An integer [[N]] is the numbr of different bricks
<<[[N]] next lines :>> a description of a brick, fields are " " separated. First is the [[brickName]], second is the [[brickSize]], next is the [[brickColor]] and finally the [[brickCount]].
Then the wall is given from top to bottom.
<<Line :>> An integer [[H]] is the height of the wall
<<Line :>> An integer [[W]] is the width of the wall
<<[[H]] next lines :>> is a string made of color letters (ex 'W' for White) and spaces for windows
data.outputDescription:
A list of lines describing in order which brick is used a which place
<<Line :>> [[brickName]] [[position]] . the position is the more left position used by the grid
